Counterpart strings that are not slugs: 'Emirate of Hacıemiroğlu', 'Emirate of Limnia' (set by the reviewer) and 'Niketas Scholares and the Scholarioi rebels' (new 1354/6-1355/5 Kerasous contest in empire-of-trebizond; a faction that held land under a year, so no rebel dossier). Trebizond _1212 (to 1214) and Nicaea _1214 (from 1214) overlap by one year on purpose: Sinope and eastern Paphlagonia changed hands in autumn 1214 and the contest pair covers it.
